svg.title: The parts of nomira and how they talk to each other
svg.desc: The nomira CLI passes its flags and nomira.conf to buildctl. BuildKit runs the frontend, which reads the recipe, its imports and the copied files and returns a build graph. BuildKit builds it and writes an OCI layout directory. bootc installs or updates the system from that directory as a composefs deployment, which systemd-boot boots.
